issues.title: Establish what a Kalawao “budget” even is
issues.detail: A county with no elected government and no appropriation ordinance.
issues.learned: Kalawao has no county budget. By HRS §326-34 it is administered by the Hawaii Department of Health; the DOH Director (Kenneth Fink) is ex-officio mayor. Its public costs are a ~$4.3M/yr line in the state DOH budget for the Kalaupapa settlement. This is the honest answer: there is no county total to walk.

issues.title: Pull the exact DOH Kalaupapa appropriation
issues.detail: The DOH legislative-report PDFs return 403 to automated fetchers; a browser-based pull would confirm the exact annual figure and staffing.
